confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear pattern of both users (user_01 and user_04) accessing sensitive files outside their departmental scope and performing high-volume downloads, including significant off-hours activity. The behavior of user_04 is particularly suspicious as they are a 'read_only' junior accountant downloading multiple large financial files and accessing engineering project directories.

attack_chain.description: user_04 (junior_accountant) begins downloading sensitive financial files, exceeding their baseline of 0 downloads per day.
user_04 accesses files in the engineering department (/data/shared/project_alpha/), which is outside their normal directory scope.
user_04 accesses files in the engineering department (/data/shared/project_beta/), further expanding access scope.
user_04 performs a large download of the general ledger (5.2MB) near the end of their session.
user_04 continues accessing engineering project files outside of normal working hours.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_04 was granted temporary cross-departmental permissions via a ticket.
No information on whether the 'read_only' access level was bypassed or if the system failed to enforce it during the download actions.
narrative: A potential insider threat incident was identified involving user_04, a junior accountant with read-only access. The user exhibited a pattern of downloading numerous sensitive financial files and accessing engineering project directories (/data/shared/project_alpha/ and /project_beta/) outside their department and normal working hours. User_01 also showed suspicious cross-departmental access and off-hours activity, suggesting a coordinated or widespread data collection effort.
